verdict.rationale: SerpApi is an API-first product. Its search engines are documented as public HTTP APIs with detailed parameter docs: location, output format (json/html/md), field filtering, async submission and the Searches Archive API. It also ships official client libraries, and probes confirmed llms.txt and markdown docs are live, while community users report using it via its API. missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all probed paths returned 404), and header-based API key auth (community notes the key is embedded in the URL).
